sourceNote: Ideas inspired by patterns from Sui Overflow 2025 winning projects. Each idea is a variation or extension, not a clone. Winners referenced: SuiSQL, ZeroLeaks, Magma, Pismo, RaidenX, Suithetic, Hyvve, OpenGraph, SuiSign, WalGraph, SuiMail, Walpress, PIVY, SeaWallet, Kamo, Shroud, Sui Sentinel, MizuPay, Suipulse, DeepMaker.

ideas.title: Academic credential vault with verifiable transcripts on Walrus
ideas.summary: Universities issue encrypted transcripts to Walrus. Students grant time-limited access to employers via Seal policies. Inspired by SuiSign's document verification pattern.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal encryption plus Walrus storage. Capability-gated reads protect student privacy.
ideas.marketSignal: Credential fraud costs employers billions annually. SuiSign proved document verification on Walrus works.

ideas.title: AI agent that reviews Move smart contracts for vulnerabilities
ideas.summary: Autonomous agent that scans Move bytecode, flags common vulnerability patterns, and produces on-chain audit receipts. Extends the OpenGraph ML verification pattern to security.
ideas.fitForSui: Nautilus TEE runs the analysis off-chain with attestation. Sui objects store audit results verifiably.
ideas.marketSignal: Smart contract exploits cost $1.7B in 2025. Automated audit tools are in high demand.

ideas.title: AI portfolio rebalancer with transparent strategy on-chain
ideas.summary: Extends Magma's AI rebalancing concept into a general portfolio manager. Strategy weights stored on-chain, every rebalance is a verifiable PTB.
ideas.fitForSui: PTBs execute multi-step rebalances atomically. On-chain strategy objects create full transparency.
ideas.marketSignal: Magma won DeFi track at Overflow 2025. Robo-advisors manage $1T+ in tradfi.

ideas.title: Anonymous employee feedback with ZK proofs of employment
ideas.summary: Employees prove they work at a company via ZK without revealing identity, then submit encrypted feedback to Walrus. Extends ZeroLeaks whistleblower pattern to corporate feedback.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal encrypts feedback. ZK proofs verify employment without doxxing. Walrus stores submissions.
ideas.marketSignal: ZeroLeaks won Crypto track. Glassdoor proves anonymous workplace feedback has massive demand.

ideas.title: Bitcoin-to-Sui DeFi bridge with trustless verification
ideas.summary: Extends MizuPay's Bitcoin liquidity pattern into a full bridge that lets BTC holders access Sui DeFi without wrapping through centralized custodians.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's programmable transactions handle the multi-step bridge flow atomically. Nautilus TEE verifies BTC state.
ideas.marketSignal: MizuPay won with Bitcoin liquidity on Sui. BTC DeFi TVL crossed $10B in 2025.

ideas.title: Collaborative spreadsheet with cells stored on Walrus
ideas.summary: Google Sheets alternative where cell data lives on Walrus, formulas execute client-side, and sharing permissions use Seal. Inspired by SuiSQL's on-chain data model.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus stores cell data cheaply. Seal gates sheet access. PTBs handle permission changes atomically.
ideas.marketSignal: SuiSQL proved structured data on Walrus is viable. Google Sheets has 900M+ users.

ideas.title: Data DAO with on-chain governance for dataset curation
ideas.summary: Community curates training datasets stored on Walrus. Members vote on inclusion and quality via on-chain governance. Extends Suithetic and Hyvve data marketplace patterns.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects represent governance votes. Walrus stores datasets. Capability-gated curation roles.
ideas.marketSignal: Suithetic and Hyvve both won AI track with data marketplaces. Data DAOs are an emerging category.

ideas.title: Decentralized CMS for blogs and landing pages on Walrus
ideas.summary: WordPress alternative where content is stored on Walrus, themes are Sui objects, and publishing is a PTB. Extends Walpress into a full content management system.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus stores content permanently. Sui objects track content metadata and ownership. No hosting vendor lock-in.
ideas.marketSignal: Walpress won Storage track. WordPress powers 40%+ of the web but has hosting and plugin security issues.

ideas.title: Encrypted email service with Seal access control
ideas.summary: Email stored on Walrus, encrypted with Seal. Recipients decrypt with their Sui wallet. Extends SuiMail with proper encryption rather than plaintext storage.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal encrypts per-recipient. Walrus stores ciphertext. zkLogin lets non-crypto users access via Google sign-in.
ideas.marketSignal: SuiMail proved decentralized email on Sui is feasible. ProtonMail has 100M+ users seeking private email.

ideas.title: Decentralized git hosting on Walrus with access control
ideas.summary: Git repos stored on Walrus. Seal gates read access for private repos. Push verified by Sui capabilities. Extends Walpress's content hosting into developer tooling.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus stores repo blobs. Seal encrypts private repos. Sui objects track contributor permissions.
ideas.marketSignal: Walpress proved content hosting on Walrus. GitHub has 100M+ developers. Decentralized git is a recurring ask.

ideas.title: Graph analytics platform on Walrus for on-chain relationship mapping
ideas.summary: Extends WalGraph's graph DB into an analytics platform. Maps wallet relationships, token flows, and protocol interactions stored on Walrus.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus stores graph data cheaply. Sui objects represent query results and access permissions.
ideas.marketSignal: WalGraph won Storage track. Blockchain analytics (Nansen, Arkham) is a billion-dollar market.

ideas.title: DeFi automation platform with conditional execution
ideas.summary: Set if-then rules for Sui DeFi actions. Example: if SUI drops below $1, sell to USDC. If Scallop rate exceeds 10%, deposit. Extends DeepMaker's automation pattern.
ideas.fitForSui: Pyth price feeds trigger conditions. PTBs execute complex DeFi operations atomically. Sui objects store automation rules.
ideas.marketSignal: Gelato and Chainlink Automation on EVM process millions of automated transactions. No Sui-native automation layer exists.

ideas.title: Real-time DeFi event streaming with alerting
ideas.summary: Extends Suipulse's data streaming into a DeFi-focused event pipeline. Streams liquidation events, large trades, and governance votes with configurable alerts.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's event system emits structured data. Walrus stores historical streams. PTBs configure alert subscriptions.
ideas.marketSignal: Suipulse won Infra track. DeFi alerting tools (DeFi Saver, Tenderly) have strong PMF.

ideas.title: Social graph database on Walrus for Sui apps
ideas.summary: Shared social graph stored on Walrus that any Sui app can read. Follow relationships, reputation scores, and interaction history in a queryable format.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus stores the graph data. Sui capabilities gate write access per app. Shared objects enable cross-app reads.
ideas.marketSignal: WalGraph demonstrated graph DBs on Walrus. Lens and Farcaster proved portable social graphs have demand.

ideas.title: ML-driven impermanent loss prediction dashboard
ideas.summary: Dashboard that predicts impermanent loss for Sui LP positions using historical price data and ML models. Extends Magma's AI rebalancing into preventive analytics.
ideas.fitForSui: Reads on-chain pool state via Sui RPC. Nautilus TEE runs ML inference. Results stored as verifiable Sui objects.
ideas.marketSignal: Magma won DeFi track with AI-driven yield. IL remains the top concern for LP providers.

ideas.title: Decentralized time-series database for IoT on Walrus
ideas.summary: IoT devices write sensor data to Walrus in time-series format. Extends SuiSQL's structured data pattern to streaming sensor data with configurable retention.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus stores time-series blobs cheaply. Sui objects track device registrations and data access policies.
ideas.marketSignal: SuiSQL proved structured data on Walrus works. IoT data management is a $30B+ market.

ideas.title: Legal document signing with court-admissible proofs on Walrus
ideas.summary: Extends SuiSign into a legally rigorous signing platform. Timestamped signatures, document hashes on Walrus, and chain-of-custody tracking via Sui objects.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus stores document hashes permanently. Sui objects track signature chain. zkLogin simplifies signer onboarding.
ideas.marketSignal: SuiSign won Storage track. DocuSign is $18B market cap. Court-admissible digital signatures are an unmet need.

ideas.title: ML model marketplace with verifiable inference receipts
ideas.summary: Model creators upload to Walrus. Buyers run inference in Nautilus TEE and receive verifiable receipts. Extends OpenGraph's ML verification to a full marketplace.
ideas.fitForSui: Nautilus TEE provides verifiable inference. Walrus stores models. Sui objects track payments and usage.
ideas.marketSignal: OpenGraph won AI track with ML verification. HuggingFace model downloads cross 5B/month.

ideas.title: Multisig payroll system with streaming payments
ideas.summary: Extends Sui Multisig CLI into a full payroll system. Multisig approvals trigger streaming payments to employees, with on-chain pay stubs.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui native multisig plus PTBs for atomic batch payouts. Objects track payroll records.
ideas.marketSignal: Sui Multisig won Payments track. Payroll platforms (Gusto, Rippling) are multi-billion category.

ideas.title: Generative art platform with art stored permanently on Walrus
ideas.summary: Artists deploy generative algorithms. Collectors mint unique outputs stored on Walrus. No IPFS dependency. Art exists as long as Walrus operates.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus stores generated art permanently. Sui objects carry the generation parameters. Kiosk handles sales and royalties.
ideas.marketSignal: Art Blocks processed $1B+ in generative art sales. Permanent on-chain storage is a key differentiator.

ideas.title: On-chain options with ML-powered pricing
ideas.summary: Options protocol where pricing is driven by ML models running in Nautilus TEE. Settlement on DeepBook. Extends RaidenX's AI trading into derivatives.
ideas.fitForSui: Nautilus TEE runs pricing models. DeepBook settles option trades. PTBs handle exercise atomically.
ideas.marketSignal: RaidenX won AI track with AI trading. Options volume on centralized exchanges exceeds $1T annually.

ideas.title: Private DAO voting with encrypted ballots on Walrus
ideas.summary: DAO members vote with Seal-encrypted ballots stored on Walrus. Votes decrypt after deadline. Extends ZeroLeaks privacy pattern to governance.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal time-locked encryption reveals votes only after deadline. Walrus stores encrypted ballots. ZK proofs verify eligibility.
ideas.marketSignal: ZeroLeaks proved ZK plus Seal on Sui. Snapshot governance has 40K+ DAOs with plaintext voting.

ideas.title: Privacy-preserving DEX with encrypted order flow
ideas.summary: Extends Shroud's private trading into a full DEX. Orders encrypted with Seal, matched in TEE, settled on DeepBook. No front-running possible.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal encrypts orders. Nautilus TEE matches without seeing cleartext on-chain. DeepBook settles.
ideas.marketSignal: Shroud won Crypto track with privacy trading. MEV extraction costs traders $500M+ annually.

ideas.title: Proof-of-location attestation service using TEE
ideas.summary: Devices prove their physical location via Nautilus TEE attestation. Location proofs stored as Sui objects. Extends Sui Sentinel's TEE attestation pattern.
ideas.fitForSui: Nautilus TEE generates signed location attestations. Sui objects store proofs verifiably.
ideas.marketSignal: Sui Sentinel won with TEE verification. Location verification is needed for insurance, logistics, and gaming.

ideas.title: Pyth-powered liquidation bot for Sui lending protocols
ideas.summary: Bot monitors Pyth price feeds and triggers liquidations on Scallop, NAVI, and Suilend. Extends Pismo's Pyth integration into a general-purpose liquidation service.
ideas.fitForSui: Pyth provides real-time price feeds. PTBs execute liquidations atomically across protocols.
ideas.marketSignal: Pismo won DeFi track using Pyth. Liquidation bots are profitable infrastructure on every lending chain.

ideas.title: Real-time on-chain data feed marketplace
ideas.summary: Providers publish live data streams (sports scores, weather, stocks) to Sui. Consumers subscribe via capability objects. Extends Suipulse streaming into a marketplace.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui shared objects enable real-time updates. Capabilities gate feed access. PTBs handle subscription payments.
ideas.marketSignal: Suipulse demonstrated data streaming on Sui. Oracle and data feed markets are growing 30%+ annually.

ideas.title: Smart wallet with social recovery and spending limits
ideas.summary: Extends SeaWallet's smart wallet into a full account abstraction layer. Social recovery via trusted contacts, daily spending limits, and dapp allowlists.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui capabilities express spending limits and recovery authority. zkLogin simplifies guardian onboarding.
ideas.marketSignal: SeaWallet won Payments track. Wallet UX and recovery remain top barriers to crypto adoption.

ideas.title: Stealth address messaging for private on-chain communication
ideas.summary: Extends PIVY's stealth address system into a messaging protocol. Sender generates one-time addresses. Recipient scans for messages without revealing identity.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's object model carries message state per-address. Stealth addresses prevent linkability.
ideas.marketSignal: PIVY won Payments track with stealth addresses. Private messaging is a recurring crypto consumer ask.

ideas.title: REST API gateway for structured data on Walrus
ideas.summary: Extends SuiSQL into a developer-friendly API layer. Store and query JSON/SQL data on Walrus via standard REST endpoints, with Sui-based auth.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus stores data blobs. Sui capabilities authenticate API access. Developers get familiar REST patterns.
ideas.marketSignal: SuiSQL proved structured data on Walrus. Firebase/Supabase developer adoption shows demand for simple data APIs.

ideas.title: Supply chain document trail on Walrus with Seal access
ideas.summary: Shipping documents, certificates of origin, and inspection reports stored on Walrus. Seal gates access by role (shipper, customs, buyer). Extends SuiSign to logistics.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus stores documents permanently. Seal encrypts per-role. Sui objects track custody chain.
ideas.marketSignal: SuiSign demonstrated document verification. Global trade documentation is a $50B+ market.

ideas.title: Synthetic training data generator with provenance tracking
ideas.summary: Generate synthetic datasets with Nautilus TEE, store on Walrus, track lineage on-chain. Extends Suithetic's data marketplace into generation.
ideas.fitForSui: Nautilus TEE generates data verifiably. Walrus stores outputs. Sui objects track provenance chain.
ideas.marketSignal: Suithetic won AI track with data marketplace. Synthetic data market projected to reach $3B by 2027.

ideas.title: TEE-based oracle network for off-chain data
ideas.summary: Network of Nautilus TEE nodes that fetch and verify off-chain data, publishing signed results to Sui. Extends Sui Sentinel's attestation into a general oracle.
ideas.fitForSui: Nautilus TEE provides trusted execution. Sui shared objects store oracle data. Move verifies attestations.
ideas.marketSignal: Sui Sentinel demonstrated TEE attestation on Sui. Oracle market is $10B+ across all chains.

ideas.title: Fair token launchpad with anti-snipe mechanics
ideas.summary: Token launch platform where initial orders are batched and Seal-encrypted to prevent sniping. Settlement via DeepBook after reveal. Extends Shroud's privacy pattern.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal encrypts launch orders. Time-lock decryption after batch close. DeepBook settles at a single clearing price.
ideas.marketSignal: Shroud proved private trading on Sui. Fair launches are the #1 community request on every DEX.

ideas.title: Trading signal marketplace with verifiable track records
ideas.summary: Signal providers publish encrypted predictions to Walrus. Track records verified on-chain after resolution. Extends RaidenX's AI trading into a marketplace model.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal time-locks predictions. Walrus stores signal history. Sui objects track verified performance.
ideas.marketSignal: RaidenX won AI track with trading signals. Copy-trading platforms (eToro) manage $30B+ in AUM.

ideas.title: Verifiable randomness service for on-chain games
ideas.summary: Nautilus TEE generates random numbers with attestation proofs. Games consume randomness via PTBs. Extends Sui Sentinel's TEE pattern to gaming.
ideas.fitForSui: Nautilus TEE provides verifiable randomness. Sui shared objects distribute random values to consumers.
ideas.marketSignal: Sui Sentinel proved TEE attestation on Sui. On-chain gaming needs provably fair randomness.

ideas.title: Anonymous press submission platform with source protection
ideas.summary: Journalists receive encrypted tips via Seal, stored on Walrus. Sources prove credentials via ZK without revealing identity. Extends ZeroLeaks into journalism.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal encrypts submissions. ZK proofs verify source credentials. Walrus stores evidence permanently.
ideas.marketSignal: ZeroLeaks won Crypto track. SecureDrop serves 70+ newsrooms but requires complex infrastructure.

ideas.title: DeFi strategy backtesting engine with on-chain data
ideas.summary: Backtest yield strategies against historical Sui DeFi data. Extends Kamo's yield trading into a simulation and backtesting platform.
ideas.fitForSui: Reads historical Sui state. Walrus stores backtest datasets. Sui objects track strategy performance records.
ideas.marketSignal: Kamo won DeFi track with yield trading. Quantitative DeFi tools are a growing niche across chains.

ideas.title: ZK credential verification SDK for Sui apps
ideas.summary: SDK that lets any Sui app verify age, nationality, or professional credentials via ZK proofs without seeing the underlying documents. Generalizes ZeroLeaks ZK pattern.
ideas.fitForSui: Move contracts verify ZK proofs on-chain. Capabilities gate what credentials each app can request.
ideas.marketSignal: ZeroLeaks demonstrated ZK on Sui. KYC compliance costs financial apps $500M+ annually.

ideas.title: ZK tax compliance proofs for DeFi users
ideas.summary: Prove tax compliance without revealing portfolio details. ZK proofs verify gains and losses match filed returns. Extends ZeroLeaks into financial compliance.
ideas.fitForSui: Move contracts verify ZK proofs on-chain. Sui objects store compliance attestations. Privacy preserved.
ideas.marketSignal: ZeroLeaks demonstrated ZK on Sui. Tax compliance is a growing concern for DeFi users in regulated markets.
